entities.summary: Enrique Burgos Calles is a Panamanian former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Kansas City Royals and San Francisco Giants, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Brother Elephants and Uni-President Lions.
